Unlike prior RLHF methods, which learn a reward and then optimize it via RL, our approach leverages a particular choice of reward model parameterization

short_excerpts: The reasoning.effort parameter guides the model on how much to think when performing a task.
Only use when your evals show a clear benefit that justifies the extra latency and cost.
sources.inspection: 實讀官方 HTML 的 Reasoning effort 內文與 effort 表：effort 是思考量／延遲／token與品質取捨的設定，模型仍自適應；high 要依任務比較 medium/high，xhigh 要有 eval 支持，max 也要求評估是否更強。其角色不是逐題正確性判準。因此導言要求另驗答對成立；沒有據此聲稱較高 effort 一定無益或一定更差。
